title: Distributions of Non-cash Assets to Owners
summary: Addresses accounting for non-reciprocal distributions of non-cash assets by an entity to its owners, including measurement of the dividend payable at fair value and recognition of any gain or loss on settlement.

related.title: Events after the Reporting Period
related.relationship: Governs when a dividend authorised after the reporting period is a non-adjusting event

related.title: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets
related.relationship: Supplies the general liability recognition principle applied to the dividend payable

related.title: Non-current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations
related.relationship: May apply to the distributed asset beforehand if it meets held-for-distribution criteria

related.title: Business Combinations
related.relationship: Supplies the definition of a business relevant to determining the nature of the non-cash asset distributed
